g.text: validate Product ID, direction and positive integer
SELECT stock row WHERE ended_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
Product active state does not prevent administrative
stock adjustment. The Manager may adjust stock for an
inactive Product. Product activation and stock quantity
Each adjustment must use a positive integer number of
abstract units. A decrease cannot make availableUnits
negative. A valid decrease to zero leaves the period open
with endedAt empty; zero stock does not end tracking.
